_whyThisCouldNotBeAssertedBefore: flagSpof.ts equated 'asserted effective=true' with 'launch-required', so honestly pinning any true flag held ON by its switchboard row (rather than by a deploy env var) fired a spurious launch-flag-off ERROR — the deploy correctly omits those env vars. The gate punished honest pinning, which is why this file stayed at 6 entries and why its hand-written pendingLaunchFlags prose rotted on 4 of 5 entries. checkFlagSpof now takes an explicit launchRequiredFlags set (2026-08-11); only those flags can produce launch-flag-off.

_launchRequiredNote: A flag belongs here ONLY when its ON-ness depends on the deploy env var — i.e. dropping the line from deploy-worker.yml would actually break the launch path. A DB-backed flag held ON by its switchboard row does NOT belong here: the row wins and the deploy has no business restating it. ENABLE_AI_EXTRACTION qualifies despite being DB-backed because aiFeatureGate's failDefault() for that one flag reads process.env (CLAUDE.md §1.6 launch path must keep serving through a DB blip). ENABLE_VERIFICATION_API is retained from the prior manifest: featureGate fails CLOSED and never reads env, so the env line is strictly inert — the pin is kept deliberately so nobody drops it while assuming it load-bearing, and flag-inventory.json records that it is not.
